description: For finite Harrop \(\Gamma\), a specified structural recursion on a supplied equality-free raw tree \(p:\Gamma\Rightarrow\exists xB\) returns either an original term with its actual instance proof or an actual proof of \(\Gamma\Rightarrow\bot\). Its six reachable cases retain the existential-right term and child, return the exact contradiction, or rebuild the same permitted left spine.
